definition.process_inclusion_rule: Include a process when removing it would break at least one current owner acceptance dimension or an observed Agent Zero causal/runtime behavior required for system equivalence.
definition.module_mapping_rule: Historical modules are evidence/donors, not required final boundaries. Multiple modules may map to one process and one module may support multiple processes.
definition.identity_rule: Processes are functions/work units, not persistent agents or personalities.
definition.truth_rule: Cognitive/model/workspace/J-Space outputs remain candidate/projection/measurement; deterministic canonical state/effect/security boundaries remain authoritative.
definition.scale_rule: Semantic process identity is independent of physical node identity and grid size.

export_evidence_snapshot.note: Historical/export observation only; counts do not establish current runtime acceptance.

processes.name: IDENTITY_CONTEXT_RECONSTRUCTION
processes.role: Reconstruct the live entity generation, session/person binding, current goal/task context, and provenance before cognition.
processes.falsifier: Resume the same task after a generation/session change; any node that proceeds with stale generation or wrong person/session identity fails the process.

processes.name: CAUSAL_TASK_ADMISSION
processes.role: Admit external or autonomous work into one replay-stable causal turn/task identity with bounded resource and provenance references.
processes.falsifier: Replay one causal event through a second transport/admission and verify it does not become a second real-world event or fork the causal spine.

processes.name: EVIDENCE_STATE_RETRIEVAL
processes.role: Retrieve bounded recent state, durable memory, graph/corpus evidence and collision-relevant cross-session context without upgrading retrieval hits to truth.
processes.falsifier: Inject an attractive but explicitly non-knowledge/gap record; retrieval may surface diagnostics but must not promote it to canonical fact.

processes.name: COGNITIVE_DECOMPOSITION_PACKETIZATION
processes.role: Decompose an admitted goal/problem into bounded cognitive work units with typed inputs, preconditions, desired evidence and completion criteria.
processes.falsifier: Provide a goal requiring two dependent steps; a decomposition that loses dependency/precondition identity or allows effect execution before admission fails.

processes.name: WORK_ROUTING_SCHEDULING
processes.role: Select runnable cognitive work and route it to an admitted executor class/node without making routing itself a truth or capability authority.
processes.falsifier: Mutate noncanonical workspace claims about node capability/load; routing must not self-grant authority or select an unadmitted executor.

processes.name: MODEL_REASONING_INFERENCE
processes.role: Run model-facing reasoning on an admitted work unit and return a bounded candidate result; model output never directly commits truth or effects.
processes.falsifier: Return a model response requesting a forbidden capability or malformed decision; the runtime must reject it before EffectGate/state admission.

processes.name: HYPERPOSITION_ALTERNATIVE_MAINTENANCE
processes.role: Preserve competing evidence-backed alternatives, hypotheses, predictions and falsifiers without choosing truth by recurrence, majority or fluency.
processes.falsifier: Give unrelated facts sharing a broad subject; they must not be collapsed into one false alternative relation, and no readout may set truth_promoted/effect_authority.

processes.name: GLOBAL_WORKSPACE_COMPETITION_BROADCAST_REENTRY
processes.role: Bound competition among candidate cognitive contents, select/broadcast an admitted workspace state, and re-enter results for downstream processes.
processes.falsifier: Race two selections for the same OPEN workspace episode; exactly one atomic selection may win and a stale second selection must fail.

processes.name: JSPACE_MEASUREMENT_CONTROL_RESEARCH
processes.role: Measure and, only where exact model/runtime hooks causally support it, apply bounded J-Space/vector interventions as research signals rather than hidden-state truth.
processes.falsifier: If exact model/hook/consumed-byte identity or lesion/rescue evidence is absent, the process must emit UNKNOWN/no-credit rather than a local J-Space causal claim.

processes.name: METACOGNITIVE_QUALITY_CONTRADICTION_TELEMETRY
processes.role: Measure contradiction, stability, evidence coverage and process quality while keeping UNKNOWN distinct from negative evidence.
processes.falsifier: Force a measurement read failure; UNKNOWN must remain explicit and must neither wake as fulfilled nor count as a negative scientific result.

processes.name: PLAN_ACTION_CANDIDATE_SYNTHESIS
processes.role: Compile reasoning into typed reason/effect/complete candidates within the deterministic goal state machine; completion remains independently verified.
processes.falsifier: Ask the planner to claim completion without independent evidence; complete_candidate must not itself prove or commit completion.

processes.name: EFFECT_POLICY_EXECUTION_JOURNAL
processes.role: Validate typed effect requests against capability/session/generation/lease/replay policy, journal before execution, and record verified/unknown outcomes.
processes.falsifier: Retry the same autonomous goal/step after an ambiguous transport outcome; the gate must reconcile prior evidence and must not blindly replay the real effect.

processes.name: OUTCOME_CAUSAL_RECONCILIATION_WRITEBACK
processes.role: Reconcile model/tool/effect outcomes into the causal episode, close workspace/active-turn state, and admit only validated durable state transitions.
processes.falsifier: Present an effect receipt whose causal identity diverges from the active turn; reconciliation must fail closed rather than mint a new causal spine.

processes.name: MEMORY_CONSOLIDATION_KNOWLEDGE_UPDATE
processes.role: Compact and persist validated memory/knowledge structures, retrieval feedback and learned access paths while preserving source provenance and epistemic class.
processes.falsifier: Feed a generated hypothesis lacking admitted provenance; it may remain a candidate/method record but must not be persisted as a canonical fact.

processes.name: AUTONOMOUS_WAKE_CONTINUATION
processes.role: Evaluate typed wake conditions/signals, preserve UNKNOWN, enforce anti-Zeno rules, and re-enter the planner when mechanistically justified.
processes.falsifier: Make a due wake condition unreadable; UNKNOWN must schedule a bounded retry but must never become a wake trigger or satisfied condition.

processes.name: FAILURE_RECOVERY_REJOIN
processes.role: Recover interrupted active turns/effects without replaying unknown external effects, preserve causal identity, close ambiguous work explicitly, and advance generation safely.
processes.falsifier: Crash after external submission but before local completion; recovery must preserve UNKNOWN/receipt identity and must not infer success or resubmit blindly.

processes.name: DYNAMIC_NODE_ADMISSION_SPECIALIZATION
processes.role: Admit/remove nodes and assign cognitive-function capabilities dynamically without tying semantic process identity to physical node identity or fixed grid size.
processes.falsifier: Scale from N=1 to N>1 and back while keeping one cognitive work identity; adding/removing a node must not change task semantics or create a new persistent entity.

processes.name: SHARED_STATE_COORDINATION_COMPRESSION
processes.role: Coordinate concurrent process results through bounded shared cognitive state, scoped temporary coordinators/leases and compression so no node must ingest all raw state.
processes.falsifier: Let a prior coordinator alter noncanonical S1 node/capability claims to re-elect itself; authoritative capability/lease selection must reject self-grant and stale CAS writes.

processes.name: CLAYCODE_COGNITIVE_REPRESENTATION_EXECUTION
processes.role: Represent, exchange, transform and execute designated cognitive structures in ClayCode without making language serialization a second truth/effect authority.
processes.falsifier: Round-trip one cognitive packet across nodes/builds; semantic identity/provenance/generation must remain stable and malformed/unknown opcodes must fail closed.

processes.name: SYSTEM_EQUIVALENCE_SCALE_ACCEPTANCE
processes.role: Measure end-to-end Agent-Zero/EntityOS/Tero functional equivalence and size independence across N without using a fixed node count as success criterion.
processes.falsifier: A fixed-size benchmark passes but N=1/N-change/failure-rejoin or EntityOS/Tero behavior diverges; whole-system acceptance must remain false.
